description: This file defines a class for generating financial reports in the Odoo ERP system, specifically for French localization. It includes methods for loading account data, setting and retrieving variables, and querying financial periods and account balances.

classes.name: base_report
classes.description: A report parser class for generating financial reports, extending report_sxw.rml_parse.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report parser and setting up local context variables.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads fiscal year and period data, and initiates account data loading based on report name.

methods.name: _set_variable
methods.description: Stores a variable in the local context.

methods.name: _get_variable
methods.description: Retrieves a variable from the local context.

methods.name: _load_accounts
methods.description: Calculates account balances based on account definitions, fiscal year state, and query conditions.
